title: Frukt Cyder Plum Red Apple Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Succulent, soft plums merge deliciously with the tangy crispness of fresh apple cider to produce a smooth, sweet and uplifting taste of summer all-year round. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend strikes the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
